about: The access that Meternaut needs outside its own resource group. The deployment workflow's identity holds no right there and must not get one (AGENTS.md rule 18), so a person who may assign roles at each place grants it. Each line of grants is one role of one identity at one place. tools/access-requirements.py reads this file: it checks what is granted and, only with --apply, grants what is missing. docs/proposals/03-access-and-onboarding.md shows the table that the tool prints, and a test keeps the two the same.

places.estate: Each subscription that the Watch reads (the app setting SCOPE_SUBSCRIPTIONS), or a management group above them
places.gatewayProductSubscription: The one subscription of the gateway's access product that the Watch uses, below the API Management instance
places.centralWorkspace: The central workspace that the component writes to
places.projectGroup: The project's own resource group, where Meternaut plants waste of its own and where its writer may act and nowhere else

Meternaut gateway key reader.description: Reads the key of one gateway subscription, so that the first cases of Meternaut can call the models through the gateway. Nothing else.

Meternaut usage reader.description: Reads one table (AppMetrics, the metrics of workspace-based Application Insights) of the central workspace, so that the usage copy job of Meternaut can read the gateway token metrics. Nothing else.

Meternaut waste remover.description: The one role of Meternaut that changes Azure. It deletes a managed disk or a public IP address in the project's own resource group, after a person approved the exact plan, and reads the same two kinds of resource and the management locks to check them first. Nothing else: no other kind of resource, no other group.

grants.why: Reads the resources, their tags and management locks, and Azure Advisor's cost recommendations: the detectors and the guards of the Watch. The role reads and changes nothing
Reads the cost lines of every resource for the last 30 days, so that every figure is Cost Management's and never a model's

Reads the one key of the gateway's access product at the start of each run, because the gateway always asks for it. The role allows that read and nothing else of the gateway (the one remaining key: AGENTS.md rule 23)
Reads the gateway's Application Insights component, where the gateway records the token metrics of every call
Reads one table (AppMetrics) of the central workspace. The component is workspace-based and the workspace asks for workspace permissions, so the role on the component alone returns no rows

The one writer: after a person approved the exact plan it deletes a disk or a public IP address in this group, after it has read the resource and the locks again, and it can do nothing else in Azure. Every other right of Meternaut only reads
